name: declaration-mode-4KiB-32x
question: Does one independent DECLARE per collective add application critical-path time or control-message contention when no future-task prediction is needed?

modes.on-submit: producer -> submit/OFFER; OFFER carries the complete TaskSpec and TaskHint

f3.gate: Run only if F1 and F2 agree on direction and mechanism; if effect is close to noise, add independent paired repeats before changing workload size.

f4.gate: Run only after F3 confirms repeatable benefit without correctness or tail regression.

gates.f3_1MiB: Run only if F1 shows directionally consistent benefit and F2 supports the same mechanism; if near noise, add paired repeats first.
gates.f4_L0_L1: Run only after F3 confirms repeatable benefit without correctness or tail regression.

interpretation: Five fixed-input repeats characterize system noise only; they are not independent seeds. Compare paired repeat differences and speedups, and do not subtract a fixed diagnostic overhead.
